query: Join Orders to Product lookup. Exclude Returned and Cancelled orders; calculate net revenue after discounts for Accessories in South. Return 2 decimal places.
For Done orders only, total net revenue after discount by region. Which region ranks second? Break ties alphabetically.
How many units were sold in the Displays category on Done orders? Exclude returned and cancelled orders.
Join the district map. Among districts with population growth from 2023 to 2024 greater than 4% and at most 6%, which had the largest 2025 population?
For 2025, compute population-weighted UrbanShare using Population as weights. Return percentage to 2 decimals.
For district A, calculate compound annual population growth from 2023 to 2025 over two annual intervals. Return percentage to 2 decimals.
Calculate weighted score = Quiz 20%, Project 30%, FinalExam 50%. Among RetakeFlag=1, what is the highest score? Return 2 decimals.
How many students have weighted score at least 85 while Quiz is below 90, using weights 20%, 30%, 50%?
Rank by weighted score descending, breaking ties by StudentID ascending. Return the third-ranked student's name.
Compute closing stock = opening + receipts − issues. Which item has the smallest closing-stock-to-ReorderPoint ratio? Tie-break alphabetically.
How many SKUs have closing stock strictly below ReorderPoint?
Calculate total closing inventory value as closing stock × UnitCost for all SKUs. Return an integer.
Compute each station's mean daily temperature range (maximum minus minimum). Which station has the second-largest mean? Tie-break alphabetically.
What percentage of station-day records had rainfall greater than 0 mm? Return 2 decimals and include %.
Sum rainfall where MaxTempC is at least 30 and MinTempC is at least 23. Return one decimal place.
Build a league table from every match: win=3 points, draw=1. Rank by points, goal difference, then goals for, all descending. Which team is second?
Which team conceded the most goals across home and away matches? Tie-break alphabetically.
Across only drawn matches, how many goals were scored in total by both teams?
Join budget and actuals by Department. Sum Q1–Q3 spend and identify the department with the largest positive remaining budget.
Across all departments, total Q2 spend divided by total Q1 spend, as a percentage to 2 decimals.
How many departments used strictly more than 75% of their QuarterBudget in Q1–Q3 combined?
Compute cost=UsageKWh×TariffPerKWh per row. Which plant had the highest total cost over January–March?
For Plant B, percentage change in UsageKWh from January to March relative to January. Return 2 decimals with %.
Combined electricity cost for all plants in February, rounded to 2 decimals.
Join loans to book catalog. Late days=max(0, calendar days between checkout and return minus LoanDaysAllowed); fee=late days×FeePerLateDay. Total fee for Science books? Return 2 decimals.
Which UserID has the largest total late days across all loans? Tie-break UserID ascending.
How many loans were returned within the allowed period, including exactly on the due day?
Exclude cancelled flights. Which carrier has the highest delay rate (delayed non-cancelled flights / all non-cancelled flights for that carrier)? Tie-break alphabetically.
For non-cancelled flights arriving at LAX, calculate passenger-weighted delay rate (DelayedFlag weighted by Passengers). Return percentage to 2 decimals.
Among non-cancelled flights, absolute difference between flight counts originating at JFK and BOS.
Aggregate admissions by WardID and join ward reference. Which ward has the highest cumulative PatientsAdmitted per bed?
Overall critical-case rate = total CriticalCases / total PatientsAdmitted; do not average ward rates. Return 2 decimals with %.
How many wards have cumulative critical-case rate strictly greater than 30%?
Compute crop value = Tonnes×1,000 kg/tonne×PricePerKg. Which region has the highest combined value across Rice and Corn?
Across all regions, weighted average PricePerKg weighted by Tonnes. Return 3 decimal places.
In which region does Corn tonnage exceed Rice tonnage by the largest amount?
Define profit=GrossM−BudgetM−MarketingM and ROI=profit/(BudgetM+MarketingM). Which film has second-highest ROI? Tie-break title alphabetically.
How many films had positive profit but gross revenue less than twice their budget?
Median profit across all films, rounded to 1 decimal place.
Join Orders to Customers and Adjustments. Include Delivered only; net value=Quantity×UnitPrice−RefundAmount, missing refund=0. Total net value for SMB segment, 2 decimals.
Using the same Delivered-only and adjustment rules, which customer Region has the highest total net order value?
Among Delivered orders only, how many have net order value strictly greater than 400 after adjustments?
Elapsed duration=EndDate−StartDate in calendar days, not inclusive. Among projects over budget, which had the longest duration? Tie-break ProjectName alphabetically.
What percentage of projects finished under budget (ActualCost < Budget)? Return 2 decimals with %.
Sum max(0, ActualCost−Budget) for projects whose elapsed duration is greater than 60 calendar days. Return integer.
